description:
Composition of the built stock in an area: unit counts, HMO share,
    mixed-use share, median building height and footprint, solar penetration.

    Medians, not means — one tower would skew an average height enough to make
    a low-rise district read as mid-rise. Percentages are whole percentages.

    `area_id` is the marts area id from `area_resolve`.

    UK only. Free.
name: area_stock_profile
title: Built-stock profile of an area
